From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Vendor onboarding: BrightBay Tech - insurance & vendor setup checklist

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the vendor setup for BrightBay Tech. We're excited to get procurement squared away so we can proceed with the pilot integration. To keep the timeline tight, could you please provide the following items by end of week (EOW):

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) covering General Liability, E&O/professional liability, and Cyber/privacy liability. See below for Redwood minimum limits.
- Completed Redwood vendor setup form (I attached the short form in the DocuSign link below) or a completed supplier onboarding PDF.
- W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax form.
- Point of contact and invoicing email for PO creation.

Redwood minimum insurance limits (standard ask):
- General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
- Errors & Omissions (Professional Liability): $2,000,000 aggregate
- Cyber Liability / Privacy: $1,000,000

When you send the COI, please confirm whether Redwood (Redwood Inference, Inc.) should be listed as Additional Insured and whether waiver of subrogation is available — this affects whether we can finalize the PO and send payment.

Upload options: you can reply with attachments to this thread, or upload to the DocuSign room linked here (DocuSign:https://app.docusign.com/rooms/ABCD1234) or to our secure vendor portal (we'll provide an upload link if preferred).

Next steps from our side: Monica will create the vendor record and initiate the PO once we have COI and W-9. Laura from Legal is cc'd for any insurance clause follow-ups.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — let me know if you need any clarifications or different timelines.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear list. We're ready to move forward. Quick answers and plan:

- We'll provide an official COI that lists General Liability, E&O, and Cyber. Our broker requires the insured limits in writing; the limits you listed are acceptable.
- BrightBay can list Redwood Inference, Inc. as Additional Insured on the General Liability policy.
- Waiver of subrogation is available on GL; for Cyber and E&O we need to confirm with the carrier (I expect yes).
- W-9 attached. We'll also include a one-page insurance summary.

Attachments in this reply: brightbay_W9.pdf (W-9), brightbay_insurance_summary.xlsx (policy summary). The broker will issue the COI tomorrow and I'll upload brightbay_COI.pdf as soon as it's generated (likely by 1/14 EOD PST).

One ask from our side: do you require certificate holder language beyond standard Additional Insured? If so please paste the exact wording.

Samantha Green
